dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is pay-per-use AI inference through lightningprox.com, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: network API calls, L402 payment flow, and prepaid spend-token authentication.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The examples instruct user-directed calls to lightningprox.com and use of LIGHTNINGPROX_SPEND_TOKEN; this is not hidden or automatic, though privacy and retention warnings could be more prominent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md and a small JSON manifest, with no executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or background workers.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to lightningprox.com and reading a spend token are proportionate for the gateway, but the token can spend prepaid funds and prompts leave the local environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, privilege escalation, local indexing, credential harvesting, or long-running process behavior is present; the artifact only notes service request logs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The concern about prompt and token transmission is valid as a privacy note, but the behavior is intrinsic to the declared AI gateway purpose and is disclosed through the endpoint, token requirement, and security manifest.
[E1] expected: External transmission to lightningprox.com is expected for this skill and appears user-directed; there is no artifact evidence of hidden exfiltration or unrelated destinations.
[staticScan:clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the artifact being documentation plus metadata only.
[VirusTotal:clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry shows no malicious or suspicious engine detections and does not conflict with the artifact review.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let the agent make paid AI requests through LightningProx. Use a limited-balance spend token, avoid sending secrets or regulated data in prompts unless you approve the service for that use, and review the optional npm SDK separately before adding it to a project.
llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed guide for using a paid LightningProx AI gateway, but prompts and a prepaid spend token are sent to LightningProx when used.
